text:
The median asking rent in Nuremberg stands at 12.89 €/m², up 4.0 % year‑on‑year and 23.3 % over the last five years, placing the city 14th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The market is balanced, with a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and listings staying on the market for an average of 31 days; 18 % are let within a week.

Affordability remains tight: the asking premium over existing rents is 57.0 %, while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 773 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 17.1 %.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 13.55 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 13.24 €/m² and 13.85 €/m², implying a 5.1 % increase.
